text:
maya: Heads up — onboarding a new HF model (meta-xxl) and seeing weird tokenization when we run quantized evals. Hate to spam; any idea why special tokens drop?
jonah: Do you have both tokenizer.json and tokenizer_config.json in the converted artifacts?
sasha: Quick question — are the files split across folders or in the same dir?
maya: Yeah. HF conversion created tokenizer.json in model/ and tokenizer_config.json in model/tokenizer/ (split). Runtime picks up tokenizer_config.json and ends up using the slow python tokenizer on prod.
jonah: Can you paste a small ls output? I suspect our fast loader isn't finding the top-level tokenizer.json.
maya: Here — ran locally:
```bash
$ ls -la model/
-rw-r--r-- 1 maya  staff  23456 Feb 10 tokenizer.json
-rw-r--r-- 1 maya  staff   5123 Feb 10 model.bin
$ ls -la model/tokenizer/
-rw-r--r-- 1 maya  staff   432 tokenizer_config.json
-rw-r--r-- 1 maya  staff   256 special_tokens_map.json
```
jonah: Yup loader bug. When model/tokenizer/ exists we prioritize tokenizer_config.json and fall back to the slow HF tokenizer. That codepath doesn't reconstruct special token mappings consistently.
ella: Quick repro: on a 4-bit quantized run I see eval regression on the convo eval set — avg turn ROUGE down ~2.1 and some prompts missing the <|system|> marker entirely.
maya: Weird — quantization shouldn't affect tokenization. Looks like missing specials cause the chat template to be built wrong and then the model receives malformed prompts.
sasha: Short-term workaround: symlink the fast artifact into the tokenizer directory (`ln -s ../tokenizer.json model/tokenizer/tokenizer.json`) or set REDWOOD_TOKENIZER_PREFERRED=fast to force the fast loader.
jonah: Long-term: change loader priority to prefer explicit tokenizer.json under model root (check model/tokenizer.json, model/tokenizer/tokenizer.json, then model/tokenizer_config.json). Also add a merge step: if tokenizer_config.json exists but special_tokens_map.json is present, reconstruct a fast-style tokenizer mapping before handing off to runtime.
maya: I'll open a tiny PR with the fix + a fallback unit test that simulates split artifacts. Also adding an eval that asserts the system token is present in final inputs.
ciro-bot: CI: quant-evals job 9823 failed on ubuntu-latest (12/12 runs failed) — see logs.
ella: :thumbsup: If someone can add the symlink hack to the dedicated bring-up guide, we can unblock the Dedicated capacity tests.
jonah: I'll cut a hotfix branch and backport to the 2.x runtime. Ping me if you need a backport release note.
maya: Thanks all — sending PR #4123 now. I'll post the before/after eval numbers once CI passes.
